verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Clerk serves an agent-oriented llms.txt at clerk.com/llms.txt and a markdown docs index at clerk.com/docs.md. Doc pages are published as .md URLs, and the changelog offers llms.txt and llms-full.txt variants. Clerk's agents page also explicitly pitches handing its docs to coding agents like Codex, and a docs-snippet MCP server supplements this. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, and evidence of a full-docs llms-full.txt beyond the changelog.
